exactSubmittedPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Draw a NEW independent avatar portrait of Takamatsu Tomori (MyGO!!!!!), exactly 1024 x 1024, with a genuinely transparent background. This is an original warm personal moment for 在场, not a scene from canon. Use the single supplied 2D portrait ONLY to recognize her short layered gray-lilac hair, airy separated bangs and rose-brown eyes. Do NOT inherit a vertically long face, adult jaw, the old exact smile, its head tilt, or its proportions. This is a fresh youth-v3 portrait, not a crop from a full-body room image.

The moment: she had offered a few carefully chosen words, unsure whether they had reached her familiar companion. She has just heard the familiar, thoughtful response. Let the eyes show the relief and small bright pleasure of actually being understood before the smile finishes arriving. Both clear rose-brown irises look gently toward the viewer, focused and alive, the brows relax naturally, and a tiny sincere upward curve becomes visible at the lips, slightly uneven as she is still a little shy about showing her happiness. She is thoughtful and present, not tearful, exhausted, blankly cute, a sales smile or laughing with a huge open mouth. Her own quiet determination remains in the gaze. Do not illustrate the story with text, props or another person.

Youth and face are essential: delicate literary 2D hand drawing with soft youthful cheeks, a naturally short rounded chin and a softly compact middle-to-lower face. Keep Tomori's recognizable eye shape and normal restrained eye size, believable eye/nose/mouth relations, subtle small nose, fine natural lips and no adult long lower jaw, deep nasolabial lines, heavy fashion lashes, dramatic makeup or mature lipstick. Young anime teenager rather than an adult glamour portrait; NEVER toddler, chibi doll, oversized glass eyes or round infant face. Do not mechanically squash the whole skull; redesign the cheek and chin planes coherently. Warm familiarity should be legible in her own eyes and mouth, not a generic repeated smile.

Keep her short gray-lilac / muted gray-brown layered hair around cheeks, jaw and nape with separate airy locks and slightly uneven bangs, not a rigid helmet or long hair. No invented bow, hair ornament, cat ears or bandage. Fine lineweight and softly painted 2D hair planes, not 3D model skin, photo realism, glossy plastic, plush toy or painterly smudges hiding the eyes. Gentle neutral studio-like soft illumination, enough cool gray base in hair and actual rose-brown irises, light natural cheek warmth, no environment-colored cast.

Composition: head and complete hair dominate the canvas, a friendly near-frontal portrait with only a few degrees of natural turn. Both eyes, brows, full cheeks, chin, top of head and all side hair are safely inside the square, ready for a small circular avatar without losing identity. Only a tiny necessary neck and hint of white shirt collar with gray-violet blazer at the very bottom; no large torso, arms, hands or shoulders taking up the picture. Avoid a long exposed neck. No room, scenery, circle frame, badge, text, watermark or colored backdrop. Preserve real alpha transparency and natural clean fine hair edges, not a checkerboard painted into the image.
